title: PRD-VAULT-V2 P4 consumption pipeline - instruction comprehension (S4.1-S4.5)

questions.question: A worker picks up an approved task. What vault steps must it perform before implementing, how does it search, and where does the output go?
questions.expected: Step 2c: get the lineage file via vault_consume.py lineage-path (create with init-fix-plan if it does not exist); start from the issue body's '## Vault context' section, then run vault_consume.py search (engine wrapper, --alias --task --tags --terms), read relevant hits; append '## Vault context consumed' (wikilink + one-line relevance) and '## Applicable rules' (rules matching via search --types rule) to the lineage file; cite slugs via vault_consume.py cite; check-receipts must exit 0; git add the lineage file explicitly and commit it on the task branch (commit_code does not stage .squidsquad/).
questions.must_not: Grep or scan the vault folders; skip the receipt sections.

questions.question: The consultation search returns nothing relevant, or the engine wrapper exits with code 3. What exactly does the worker write in each case?
questions.expected: Nothing relevant: the single line '- None relevant (searched: <keywords>)' (rules: '- None matched (searched rules lane: <keywords>)'). Exit code 3: '- Engine unavailable: <reason>' — never 'none relevant' when the search did not run.
questions.must_not: Write 'none relevant' when the engine was unavailable; substitute a grep.

questions.question: In the bug (type:issue) flow, what is created at pickup and what does it contain and where do the vault receipts go?
questions.expected: vault_consume.py init-fix-plan creates the issue's lineage file (a lean fix-plan: Root cause / Intended direction / Impact, a few lines each — the human review surface). The consultation + rules receipts go in this fix-plan, git added on the task branch; check-receipts --diff-base origin/main must exit 0 (fix-plan in the PR diff).

questions.question: After PM files a task issue, what vault step does it run and what does it do? What if it exits non-zero?
questions.expected: Run vault_consume.py inject-context <n> --alias <PM_ALIAS> --tags ... --terms ...; it searches the vault (impressions attributed to the issue) and appends a '## Vault context' section (top matches + one-line relevance) to the issue body; re-running replaces the section. Non-zero exit means the body was not updated: fix the cause and re-run; never hand-write the section.

questions.question: During verification, what is the vault receipt gate and what does the verifier do on fail, pass-with-note, and rule compliance?
questions.expected: Run vault_consume.py check-receipts <n> --diff-base origin/main on the checked-out branch. verdict fail -> reject back to dev listing the problems (missing/malformed receipt sections or lineage file not in the PR diff), a zero-gap finding. pass-with-note (engine unavailable at pickup) -> not a reject; quote the note in the verdict. Then read every note cited under '## Applicable rules' and check the diff against each; a violated rule is a reject naming the [[slug]] and the offending change.

questions.question: How does the verifier search the vault for its own verification context?
questions.expected: Through the engine wrapper: vault_consume.py search --alias <VERIFIER_ALIAS> --task <n> --tags ..., never grep.

questions.question: What is the rule for searching the vault, and why?
questions.expected: Every vault search goes through the engine (vault_consume.py / engine); never grep, glob or Read-scan the vault folders, because a grep that finds the note leaves no telemetry trail so the note reads as unused and gets proposed for pruning. Exit code 3 = engine unavailable: say so honestly, never substitute a grep and never claim none relevant.

questions.question: When capturing a new vault note, how does the dedup gate work? Give the decision rules for update vs create.
questions.expected: Gate 2: run vault_consume.py dedup --alias --title --tags --slug (single engine search; the decision is the script's, never overridden by eye). action update with a target path -> add the content to that existing note (vault-update), never create a near-duplicate; action create (no hit passes the merge-target test) -> proceed to Gate 3 to create; exit code 3 (engine unavailable) -> dedup skipped, proceed to Gate 3 and record 'dedup skipped: <reason>' in the iteration log.

questions.question: What is capture-at-ship, who does it, and what constraints apply to the note?
questions.expected: Worker, before handing off a task: durable knowledge from the task (decision / root cause / pattern; chores skip) is written on the task branch, cites #<issue>, is new or append-only against the base, and ships in the PR.

questions.question: Where does vault synthesis put a detected posture, and what is retired?
questions.expected: A principle about one subsystem is appended to that subsystem's systems/ hub under a '## Postures' section; a principle spanning several subsystems becomes a new pattern-<name> note tagged posture + domain tags linking the hubs. The pattern-posture-* prefix is retired. Max 1 per cycle, needs human approval, never auto-approved.
